pkgmetadata.longdescription: Claude Desktop, Anthropic's Claude app (Chat, Cowork, Claude Code), as a repackage of the amd64 .deb from Anthropic's apt repository (downloads.claude.ai/claude-desktop/apt/stable, suite stable). The Electron bundle is installed under /usr/lib/claude-desktop with the claude-desktop launcher, the desktop entry and the icons. Upstream's Linux app is a beta for Debian and Ubuntu; it does not update itself, so update by upgrading the package.
